name: modal.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  modal.scss — the expand modal (dialog.modal-above) + below content lock:
//  fullscreen dialog over the page with the media figure expanded inside,
//  the circular WebGL close bar at top, and the scroll-lock rules on
//  html/body while open (mirrors the JS scroll-lock in App.js).
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../base/variables';
@import '../../base/mixins';
@import '../../base/fonts';
@import '../../base/placeholders';

// Scroll-lock while any modal is open (JS adds .modal-open to <html>/<body>).
html.modal-open,
html.modal-open body,
html:has(.modal-open),
html:has(.modal-open) body,
html:has(dialog[open].modal-above),
html:has(dialog[open].modal-above) body {
  overflow: hidden;
}

// The expand dialog: fixed fullscreen layer above everything (media expand view).
dialog.modal-above,
.modal-above {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  width: 100vw;
  max-width: 100vw;
  height: 100vh;
  height: 100dvh;
  max-height: 100dvh;
  border: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
  z-index: 9999;
  overflow-y: auto;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
  background: var(--bg-dark);
  color: inherit;

  &::backdrop {
    background: var(--bg-dark);
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
  }
}

// Page state when a modal is open.
.modal-open {
  // Lock page scroll behind the modal
  body {
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .modal-below {
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    position: fixed;
  }

  // Hide regular nav links in modal context
  .nav .nav-link {
    display: none;
  }

  // Show modal title bar instead
  .modal-titlebar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
  }
}

$_B_EXPAND: 'expand-modal';
$_B_PREF_CLOSE: 'pref-close';

// Expand modal inner layout — media centered with genie zoom in/out (modal-zoom-* keyframes).
.#{$_B_EXPAND} {
  &-open-1 {
    @extend %RESETBTN;
    @extend .ttl-xs;

    // Animated border-corner button style (like the internal arrows)
    position: absolute;
    bottom: to-rem($space-lg);
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: to-rem($space-xs) to-rem($space-lg);
    color: var(--color-white-raw);
    background: transparent;
    font-weight: 700;
    white-space: nowrap;
    transition:
      color 0.2s ease,
      opacity 0.2s ease;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(2px);
    backdrop-filter: blur(2px);
    // The animated corner borders
    &::before,
    &::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      width: to-rem($space-md);
      height: to-rem($space-md);
      transition:
        width 0.25s ease,
        height 0.25s ease;
    }

    &::before {
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--color-white-raw);
      border-left: 1px solid var(--color-white-raw);
    }

    &::after {
      bottom: 0;
      right: 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-white-raw);
      border-right: 1px solid var(--color-white-raw);
    }

    .internal-expand:hover &,
    .internal-expand:focus & {
      color: var(--color-white-raw);

      &::before,
      &::after {
        width: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-xs)});
        height: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-xs)});
      }
    }
  }

  &-open-2 {
    // Hidden — open-1 is the sole expand trigger
    display: none;
  }

  &-close-bar {
    @extend %MAXAREA;
    left: 0;
    top: to-rem($space-lg);
    position: fixed;
    display: flex;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: 100%;
    z-index: 100;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;

    &-title {
      @extend .ttl-xs;

      color: var(--text-muted-on-dark);
      font-weight: 200;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      max-width: 60%;
    }

    // Self-contained close control: <media-expanded> adopts modal.scss only,
    // so it cannot rely on preferences.scss for canvas geometry or fallback.
    .#{$_B_PREF_CLOSE}-btn {
      @extend %RESETBTN;

      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      overflow: hidden;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      width: to-rem($space-2xl);
      height: to-rem($space-2xl);
      border-radius: var(--radius-round);
      color: var(--color-white-raw);
      background: var(--border-color);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition:
        background 0.2s ease,
        transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);

      .#{$_B_PREF_CLOSE}-canvas {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        border-radius: var(--radius-round);
        pointer-events: none;

        &.is-fallback {
          display: none;
        }
      }

      // Explicit CSS X remains authoritative until WebGL initializes and
      // returns whenever context creation/rendering fails. The adjacent-
      // sibling switch avoids relying on :has(), preserving old-browser
      // fallback behavior.
      .#{$_B_EXPAND}-close-bar-fallback {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        display: block;
        pointer-events: none;

        &::before,
        &::after {
          content: '';
          position: absolute;
          top: 50%;
          left: 50%;
          width: to-rem($space-lg);
          height: to-rem($space-2xs);
          border-radius: var(--radius-round);
          background: currentColor;
          transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
        }

        &::before {
          transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(45deg);
        }

        &::after {
          transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(-45deg);
        }
      }

      .#{$_B_PREF_CLOSE}-canvas:not(.is-fallback) + .#{$_B_EXPAND}-close-bar-fallback {
        display: none;
      }

      &:hover,
      &:focus-visible {
        background: var(--border-item-hover);

        .#{$_B_EXPAND}-close-bar-fallback::before {
          transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(135deg);
        }

        .#{$_B_EXPAND}-close-bar-fallback::after {
          transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(45deg);
        }
      }
    }

    &-button {
      @extend %RESETBTN;
      @extend .ttl-xs;

      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-muted-on-dark);
      cursor: pointer;
      z-index: 1;
      padding: to-rem($space-xs) to-rem($space-md);
      position: relative;
      transition: color 0.2s ease;

      // Animated corner borders
      &::before,
      &::after {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        width: to-rem($space-md);
        height: to-rem($space-md);
        transition:
          width 0.2s ease,
          height 0.2s ease;
      }

      &::before {
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        border-top: to-rem(1) solid currentColor;
        border-left: to-rem(1) solid currentColor;
      }

      &::after {
        bottom: 0;
        right: 0;
        border-bottom: to-rem(1) solid currentColor;
        border-right: to-rem(1) solid currentColor;
      }

      &:hover,
      &:focus-visible {
        color: var(--color-white-raw);

        &::before,
        &::after {
          width: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-xs)});
          height: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-xs)});
        }
      }
    }
  }

  &-close-area {
    @extend %MAXAREA;

    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  // Styled as a proper button with animated corner borders — BELOW content
  &-close-bottom {
    @extend %RESETBTN;
    @extend .ttl-xs;

    margin: to-rem($space-3xl) auto to-rem($space-xl);
    display: block;
    color: var(--text-muted-on-dark);
    font-weight: 700;
    cursor: pointer;
    position: relative;
    padding: to-rem($space-sm) to-rem($space-xl);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: to-rem(2);
    transition: color 0.2s ease;

    // Animated corner borders
    &::before,
    &::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      width: to-rem($space-md);
      height: to-rem($space-md);
      transition:
        width 0.2s ease,
        height 0.2s ease;
    }

    &::before {
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      border-top: 1px solid currentColor;
      border-left: 1px solid currentColor;
    }

    &::after {
      bottom: 0;
      right: 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid currentColor;
      border-right: 1px solid currentColor;
    }

    &:hover,
    &:focus-visible {
      color: var(--white);

      &::before,
      &::after {
        width: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-xs)});
        height: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-xs)});
      }
    }
  }

  &-content {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    position: relative;
    overflow: visible;
    background-color: var(--bg-dark);
    padding: to-rem($space-3xl) to-rem($space-xl);
    min-height: 100vh;
    min-height: 100dvh;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    transform-origin: center top;

    // Zoom-in on open
    animation: modal-zoom-in 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) forwards;

    @include layout-1024() {
      padding: to-rem($space-5xl);
    }
  }

  // Closing state: zoom-out animation
  &--closing {
    transform-origin: center top;
    animation: modal-zoom-out 0.32s cubic-bezier(0.55, 0, 1, 0.45) forwards;
  }

  // Video-specific modal layout: max 100ch minus padding, contained vertically so close button sits below without scrolling
  &-content--video {
    justify-content: space-between;
    height: 100vh;
    height: 100dvh;
    max-height: 100vh;
    max-height: 100dvh;
    padding-top: to-rem($space-4xl);
    padding-bottom: to-rem($space-xl);

    .#{$_B_EXPAND}-close-bottom {
      margin: to-rem($space-md) auto 0;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
  }

  &-media {
    &-figure {
      position: relative;
      display: block;
      // Preserve intrinsic media width: narrow screenshots stay pixel-sharp
      // instead of being stretched to the modal's full content width.
      width: fit-content;
      max-width: 100%;
      margin: 0 auto;
      border-radius: to-rem($space-md);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
      overflow: hidden;
      background-color: var(--bg-dark);

      &--video {
        max-width: min(100%, calc(100ch - 4rem));
        max-height: calc(100vh - 12rem);
        max-height: calc(100dvh - 12rem);
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        flex: 1;
        width: 100%;
        margin: 0 auto;
        box-shadow: none;
        background-color: transparent;
      }
    }

    &-placeholder {
      display: block;
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      max-width: 100%;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 0;
      opacity: 0.5;
    }

    &-item {
      display: block;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      width: auto;
      height: auto;
      max-width: 100%;

      @include layout-1024() {
        border-radius: to-rem($space-lg);
      }

      &--video {
        max-width: 100%;
        max-height: calc(100vh - 12rem);
        max-height: calc(100dvh - 12rem);
        width: auto;
        height: auto;
        object-fit: contain;
        border-radius: to-rem($space-md);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
      }
    }
  }

  &-image {
    width: auto;
    max-width: 100%;
    height: auto;
  }

  &-video {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    height: auto;
  }
}

// ── Zoom-in: scale up + fade from bottom ──────────────────────────────────
@keyframes modal-zoom-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(0.7) translateY(40px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: scale(1) translateY(0);
  }
}

// ── Zoom-out: scale down + fade to bottom ─────────────────────────────────
@keyframes modal-zoom-out {
  from {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: scale(1) translateY(0);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(0.7) translateY(40px);
  }
}

// Circular close button inside the expand modal (smaller than the pref dialog's).
.#{$_B_PREF_CLOSE}-btn {
  @extend %RESETBTN;

  -webkit-appearance: none;

  appearance: none;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: to-rem($space-3xl);
  height: to-rem($space-3xl);
  border-radius: var(--radius-round);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  outline: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: none;

  &::before,
  &::after {
    content: none;
    border: none;
  }

  .#{$_B_PREF_CLOSE}-canvas {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: var(--radius-round);
    display: block;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
}

// Keyboard focus ring on this shadow root's tabbable elements — the file
// doesn't import _structure (which emits it globally), so include the
// shared scope explicitly.
@include focus-ring-scope;
